title: ProjectM TV structured source appearance v1
description: Documentation shape schema. Hashes, source/context support and reconstruction readiness require producer/consumer checks. Not a calibrated image or mood predictor.

scope.const: unmasked source RGB oscillators between shader-clock wraps

switch_triggers.description: Contributing direct-band comparison sites; empty does not prove no flashing.

time_switch_events.description: Supported nominal source-time event sites, nonexhaustive; empty does not certify smoothness. Clock/native rounding, reachability and visible consequences remain separate.

overlap_aggregation.const: sum; repeated coverage counted multiple times

wave_material.description: Native built-in waveform channel controls, vertex RGB and conditional alpha/gate recipes; no displayed flashing/colour certificate.

scope.const: selected warp RGB before storage/drawing/detail, holding sample coordinates fixed

scenario_colour_envelope.description: Additional caller-declared input bounds; retains separate ordinary stage ranges and scenario identity.

main_frame_q.description: Source q1..q32 main-frame snapshots before pixel writes; explicit float32 upload, dynamic programs symbolic and GPU binding unobserved.

snapshot_phase.const: after main-frame code; before per-pixel Q writes

native_warp_recipe.description: Conditional nominal uniform native mesh map; runtime aspect and texel offsets required. Not a GPU precision or visible-motion certificate.

native_warp_transport.description: Conditional uniform affine-component scaling envelopes in aspect-corrected source coordinates; no complete-map Jacobian or displayed-motion claim.

controls.description: Independent control rows retain unknown values and timing. uniform_across_vertices requires pure expressions over readonly inputs or explicitly scoped main/init scalar snapshots. Pixel/shared state and random/memory calls remain guarded.

native_radial_zoom.description: Conditional positive uniform-control initial radial zoom component; no visible family/whole-map or native precision certificate.

native_warp_displacement.description: Nominal per-step backward sampling RMS expression/bound in aspect-corrected source coordinates; not forward feature or displayed speed.

feedback_envelope.description: Conditional nominal varying affine sampled-main RGB envelopes, holding coordinates/nonimage inputs fixed. Not native/full-loop/visible persistence certification.

scenario_colour_envelope.description: Additional caller-declared input bounds; retains separate ordinary stage ranges and scenario identity.

texture_colour_envelopes.description: Conditional independent affine texture-input colour boxes/norms; declared texture identities, not observed bindings or a shared recurrence.

scenario_colour_envelope.description: Additional caller-declared input bounds; retains separate ordinary stage ranges and scenario identity.

nonlinear_texture_colour_bounds.description: Conditional nonlinear scalar colour ranges and independent sampled-lane Lipschitz ceilings; no full-coordinate, feedback or display certificate.

scenario_colour_envelope.description: Additional caller-declared input bounds; retains separate ordinary stage ranges and scenario identity.

nominalAudioResponse.description: Sufficient nominal scalar partial response; other inputs fixed. Not visible or time-rate certification.

scenario_deformation_envelope.description: Additional caller-declared input assumptions; unconstrained envelope remains unchanged.

scenario_offset_envelope.description: Additional conditional bounds using the declared scenario; ordinary bounds remain unchanged.

sourceActivityMechanisms.description: Source flash mechanisms and per-step/geometry movement quantities; visible verdicts remain unknown.

shader_change_bounds.description: Raw shader RGB partial source-time rates with sampled colours and all other inputs held fixed; excludes texture motion/history and total displayed variation.

material_change_bounds.description: Conditional per-shape material partial time-rate ceilings at fixed geometry, barycentrics and destination; not visible flash rates.

texture_motion_bounds.description: Per-lookup partial time speeds and supported RGB-response-weighted bilinear worst-case coefficients; actual uploaded texture dimensions and fixed texel/content premises remain inputs.

native_lookup_transport.description: Native feedback-step RMS displacement propagated through affine warp lookups; positive renderer aspects remain inputs. Not a temporal or pointwise speed.
